description: I am a curious and hardworking student interested in science, technology, innovation and problem solving. I enjoy sharing ideas and learning from others. I believe teamwork brings out the best in everyone. I am looking for creative, committed and open minded teamates with skills in research, programming, design and communication. Together, we can learn, grow and turn ideas into reality.
summary:
Our project is an interactive space exploration game that puts players in the role of astronauts managing their own lunar outpost. Instead of simply learning facts about space, players experience the real challenges of living on the Moon by making decisions that affect the survival and success of their mission.

Players must manage essential resources such as oxygen, energy, food and radiation protection while completing scientific missions and maintaining their base. Every decision has consequences: using more energy for research may leave less power for life support, while improving radiation protection may require sacrificing other resources.

Through interactive missions, realistic space environments and resource-management challenges, the game makes complex space science easier and more exciting for young learners. It encourages critical thinking, problem-solving and an understanding of the engineering decisions astronauts face.

Our goal is to turn space exploration into a hands-on learning experience, helping young people understand that successfully living beyond Earth requires more than advanced technology; it requires careful planning, teamwork and smart decisions.
details:
About Our Project

Our project is an interactive lunar exploration game that allows players to experience what it might be like to live and work on the Moon. Players take on the role of astronauts, explore the lunar surface, complete missions and help maintain a functioning lunar base.

The game includes different missions, such as collecting Moon rocks, maintaining solar panels, driving a lunar rover, repairing habitats, establishing communication with Earth and taking care of plants in a greenhouse. Through these activities, players discover some of the challenges astronauts face when exploring space, including limited energy, oxygen supplies, food production and radiation exposure.

We created this project because we believe that learning about space should be more than reading facts from a textbook. We want students to explore, interact and learn through experience. By playing the game, they can develop problem-solving skills, curiosity, creativity and a better understanding of science and technology.

One thing that makes our project special is the way it combines entertainment with education. Instead of simply explaining how a lunar mission works, we give players an opportunity to experience different responsibilities and understand why every decision matters.

While developing the project, we considered the needs of young learners, making the experience easy to understand, interesting to explore and educational at the same time. We also considered the importance of representing lunar conditions and the challenges of maintaining human life beyond Earth.

We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript to develop the website, together with 3D design tools to create the environment and visual elements.

Our biggest goal is to inspire young people to become curious about space exploration and realize that the future of exploring other worlds depends on science, teamwork, creativity and good decision-making.
